fragment.choose:
<when condition="@{
        var required = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("required-role", null);
        if (required == null) { return false; }
        var roles = ((Jwt)context.Variables["jwt"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("roles", "");
        return !roles.Split(',').Contains(required);
    }">
      
        
        
          application/problem+json
        
        @{
            return new JObject(
                new JProperty("type", "https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.4"),
                new JProperty("title", "Forbidden"),
                new JProperty("status", 403),
                new JProperty("detail", "El token no incluye el rol requerido: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("required-role", "")),
                new JProperty("instance", context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path),
                new JProperty("traceId", context.RequestId.ToString())
            ).ToString();
        }
